svg.title: DeepSWE v1.1 task completion versus cost
svg.desc: Two studies on 113 tasks using Codex CLI and GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol. Plan/Execute: 60.8% ± 5.3 at $180.51 ± 9.43 per run; paired Sol: 62.8% ± 3.1 at $720.95 ± 19.47; paired Luna: 51.0% ± 3.7 at $50.02 ± 1.04. Advisor: 57.5% ± 3.2 at $208 ± 22 per run; paired Sol: 62.8% ± 3.1 at $743; paired Luna: 46.9% and 52.2%, about $49 per run, two valid runs. Error bars are sample standard deviations over three runs where reported, not confidence intervals. Stage: 76/113 tasks (67.3%), one run, no paired baseline; cost was not reported, so Stage is not plotted.
